Small compact leaf warbler with clear wingbar, looked dusky white on underparts but light was poor. In photos a second smaller wingbar could be seen nearer shoulder. Responded to play back of Hume's Leaf Warbler call with quite low pitched descending "tsee o", not the high pitched "swe-eet"call of Yellow-browed Warbler, did not respond to YBW call. Later it called a three times without any playback, gave same Hume's call. Recorded calls on 10 /11/26 fit YbW better.
Feeding in willows, warblers with greyish brown upperparts and brownish white underparts, with white supercilium. Also gave typical Common Chiffchaff "hweet" call.
seen feeding in willows but not enough detail to determine subspecies.
